search_evidence.limitation: This is a search ledger, not the missing corpus. It does not make any representative set equivalent to the required 842/5562 selection.

searches.result: References and other corpora were found, including the Phase 1 design/ADR and local server-history exports; no exact raw bundle plus selection manifest was present. Structured JSONL counts are recorded in corpus_manifest.json entries.
searches.scope: workspace source, docs, fixtures, scripts, replay outputs, and ignored files

searches.command: Get-ChildItem . -Recurse -File -Filter *.zip; inspect every ZIP member ending in .jsonl
searches.result: 7 non-venv ZIP files inspected. Dialogue members were 5/26, 60/320, 5/26, 60/320, and 60/320 dialogues/turns; one RAG JSONL was not dialogue-shaped. No 842/5562 member was found.
searches.scope: workspace ZIP archives, including ignored output archives

searches.result: No commit matched the exact-number history search. A broader -S842 hit was inspected and contained only unrelated substrings such as Chinese text/code and CSS colors.

searches.command: git branch --all; git tag; git stash list
searches.result: Only the current main branch was present; no tag, additional historical branch, or stash contained a recoverable corpus.
searches.scope: git refs, tags, branches, and stash

searches.command: Search project-named directories, temp roots, outputs, data, evals, fixtures, logs, and archive extensions under the current user profile
searches.result: No second ai-review-system workspace or 842/5562 candidate bundle was found. Pytest temp data contained only small test fixtures.
searches.scope: project-related user archives and temporary directories

searches.command: Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath 'E:\桌面\测试反馈' -Recurse -File | filter .json/.jsonl/archive extensions; parse dialogue-shaped JSONL counts
searches.result: 5 JSONL candidates: 5000_test_cases.jsonl has 5000 flat {text} rows; 5000条异常明细.jsonl has 567 flat anomaly rows; dialogue-shaped sets contain 36/36, 400/670, and 150/261 dialogues/turns. No archive candidate and no 842/5562 dialogue bundle.
searches.scope: documented absolute path E:\桌面\测试反馈

missing_delta_analysis.inference: The unusually long average and absence from flat GLM files indicate a likely server-only historical conversation selection, not the 5000 flat text generator.
